title.zh: 分类未定时的生成比较与组织要求
title.en: Generative comparison and required organization under unsettled classification

claim.zh: 固定新内容的实际含义与正面解释时，既有两层比较在所有新内容分类下严格支持 A 胜于 B，恰当且仅当 A 保留 B 的全部新内容、且全列一般增益时 A 仍严格更好。等价地，两端点分类的同向严格比较覆盖所有混合分类。此输出接成每种分类下的组织形成要求，但不保证同一方案在所有分类下未被击败。
claim.en: For fixed meanings and positive interpretation of fresh contents, the existing two-tier comparator strictly prefers A to B under every fresh classification exactly when A retains all fresh contents of B and is better with all fresh contents secondary. Equivalently, strict agreement at both extreme assignments covers every mixed assignment. This supplies required formation under each classification, without ensuring a common undefeated implementation.

hypotheses.zh: 同一展开中的旧、新内容、其实际实现与损失有稳定对应；新内容的生成意义已依 G0 说明，仅优先层次未定。
hypotheses.en: Old and fresh contents, their realization and losses have stable correspondence within one unfolding. Fresh generative significance has its G0 interpretation; only priority tier varies.

hypotheses.zh: 比较明确采用既有 J1/J2 的基本保护严格包含，或基本相同而一般增益严格包含；旧分类固定，一次比较中同一新内容的分类一致。
hypotheses.en: The comparator explicitly uses existing J1/J2: strict basic inclusion, or strict gain inclusion at equal basic profiles. Old tiers remain fixed and a fresh classification is consistent across the comparison.

hypotheses.zh: 组织推论另需有限非空且有实践根据的候选范围，以及每个未形成情形的合格稳健改善见证。
hypotheses.en: The formation corollary additionally requires a finite nonempty practically warranted menu and an eligible robust improvement witness for every unformed case.

hypotheses.zh: 所有分类谓词组成保守数学检验范围；不假定每种任意分类都有现实伦理根据。
hypotheses.en: All classification predicates form a conservative mathematical test family; arbitrary assignments are not presumed ethically warranted in reality.

correspondence.zh: 旧／新是同一生成内容被辨明的先后；基本／一般为已有实践承诺中的作用差异，不是两类本体或独立所有者。共同能力的应用直接取既有同一事件法则的共同组合扩展；其正面意义与成本覆盖仍明示。
correspondence.en: Old/new tracks recognition of contents in one unfolding; basic/secondary tracks their roles under existing practical commitments, not two ontologies or independent owners. The joint-capacity application directly consumes a joint-bundle extension under the existing single event law; positive significance and cost coverage remain explicit.

detail.zh: 复用比较、非自反性与传递性；不重证规范前提。
detail.en: Reuses comparison, irreflexivity and transitivity without re-proving normative premises.

input.zh: classification_robust_iff 的比较及 formation_required_without_fixed_classification 的严格序。
input.en: Comparison in classification_robust_iff and strict-order inputs to formation_required_without_fixed_classification.

conditions.zh: G0/J 与实际对应仍须有根据；不是逻辑公理审计所取得。
conditions.en: G0/J and actual correspondence retain their substantive warrant, not supplied by logical axiom auditing.

detail.zh: 每种 q 的稳健改善见证进入既有组织命题。
detail.en: Robust improvement witnesses for each q enter the existing organizational theorem.

output.zh: formation_required_of_improvable_absence 将每个缺失者的改善转成非空 Required。
output.en: formation_required_of_improvable_absence converts improvement of every deficient option into nonvacuous Required.

input.zh: formation_required_without_fixed_classification 为每种 q 提供该输入并输出作用要求。
input.en: formation_required_without_fixed_classification supplies that input for each q and obtains a required role.

conditions.zh: 有限非空合格范围及真实实践对应；未推出一个跨分类共同方案。
conditions.en: Finite nonempty eligible scope and actual practical correspondence; no common cross-classification implementation follows.

detail.zh: 直接使用其中的结构输出，不把 C 或伦理许可当作自动结果。
detail.en: Directly uses its structural output, not C or ethical permission as automatic conclusions.

output.zh: RelationalGrounding.joint_bundle_extension 给出共同组合保留与一项新增生成组合。
output.en: RelationalGrounding.joint_bundle_extension supplies joint-bundle preservation and one new generative bundle.

input.zh: joint_enrichment_is_strict 构造 freshJoint 的严格包含；joint_enrichment_without_fixed_classification 接入分类命题。
input.en: joint_enrichment_is_strict constructs strict freshJoint inclusion; joint_enrichment_without_fixed_classification applies the classification theorem.

conditions.zh: 共同能力的正面对应、旧基本相同、无所表示旧增益；现实损失覆盖不由事件法则证明。
conditions.en: Positive joint-capacity correspondence, equal old basic profiles and no represented old gains; the event law does not prove real cost coverage.

detail.zh: 复用其已完成的正面理由地位；本轮较强的比较条件不能成为该结果或一切行动的新门槛。
detail.en: Credits its completed positive-ground result; this stronger comparison criterion is not a new gate for that result or all action.

detail.zh: classification_can_matter_with_real_loss 保留新增与真实旧机会损失；三路构造同时满足各分类下的形成要求而不存在共同未被击败方案。
detail.en: classification_can_matter_with_real_loss retains a new gain and actual old opportunity loss; the three-route construction requires formation under each classification yet has no common undefeated option.

limitations.zh: 只检验已辨明正面内容的优先分类；不是新生活的一般基本地位识别、现实统一最佳方案、G0/J 无前提证明或必然服从。稳健严格比较为充分根据，不是一切合理行动的必要条件；三路反例不证明完整生活关系允许任意分类。
limitations.en: Tests priority classification of positively understood contents, not universal basic-status recognition, a real common best plan, premise-free G0/J or inevitable compliance. Robust strictness is sufficient, not necessary for every justified action; the three-route example does not show that full living relations allow arbitrary classifications.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 实查13项新定理声明／25项审计，73项继承定理／144项审计分列；新增15项空依赖、2项 propext/Quot.sound、8项另含 Classical.choice，无自定义公理。作者反审；无新经验验证或独立 agent 验收。
validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1 checked 13 new theorem declarations/25 audits; 73 inherited theorems/144 audits are separate. New audits: 15 empty, 2 propext/Quot.sound, 8 also Classical.choice; no custom axioms. Author counterreview, with no new empirical validation or independent-agent acceptance.

next_delta.zh: 复用已完成的分类稳健比较与作用要求；具体方案确实随尚有根据的分类改变时，辨明会改变决定的生活作用、替代与真实损失，不重开一般分类、正面理由或机构授权之墙。
next_delta.en: Reuse completed robust comparison and role requirements. Where implementation really depends on still-warranted classifications, establish decision-relevant living roles, alternatives and actual losses rather than reopening universal classification, positive ground or the authority wall.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3b（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述，排中律为具名假设，并表明它恰是所需。前向（各分类下严格偏好推出保留新内容、以新内容为次级时更好）不需任何原则（compared_retains、compared_secondary）。反向在外围以经典推理证明；桥接以 em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p 证明之（classification_robust_iff_of_em、two_extremes_suffice_of_em）。排中律不能去掉：对一切类型成立此反向，恰当每一命题已定（classification_robust_iff_iff_em）；见证取一个新内容，其在 b 处的保留是任意命题 R，使其为基本的分类下的严格偏好即 R 或其否定。比较仍是 PracticalJudgment 的 Better，即核心的 BetterAt。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围；桥接自此导入 ClassificationRobustJudgment，脊柱运行将其（及 RelationalOrganization、ConcernExtension）作为继承模块编译。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3b (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine, with excluded middle a named hypothesis shown to be exactly what is needed. The forward direction, from strict preference under every classification to retaining the fresh contents and being better with them secondary, needs no principle (compared_retains, compared_secondary). The periphery proves the converse classically; the bridge proves it with em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p (classification_robust_iff_of_em, two_extremes_suffice_of_em). Excluded middle cannot be dropped: the converse holds for all types exactly where every proposition is decided (classification_robust_iff_iff_em); the witness takes one fresh content whose retention at b is an arbitrary proposition R, and strict preference under the classification making it basic is R or its failure. The comparison is still PracticalJudgment’s Better, the core’s BetterAt. Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope; the bridge now imports ClassificationRobustJudgment, which the spine run compiles, with RelationalOrganization and ConcernExtension, as inherited modules.

history.en: 16 October 2026, P114, the apart modules read on the shared base (study section 138; Ren, 15 October: “so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”): the main law stated on the shared base, no premise added: (bridge Becoming.CoursesBridge) on a frame's configurations, the basic contents being what the frame realizes there: strict preference under every classification of fresh contents is retaining them and being better with them as gains, with excluded middle named (frame_classification_robust_iff_of_em); along a generative extension (a realizes everything b realizes and a living content b lacks) no excluded middle is needed, and a is strictly preferred under every classification exactly when it keeps every fresh content of b (extension_classification_robust, extension_classification_robust_iff): excluded middle is needed only where the basic contents are the same on both sides and the comparison passes to gains. Becoming.CoursesBridge is compiled and audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T172257.067968Z), with empty axiom reports. Claims, hypotheses, Ren's words, dependencies and the earlier proofs are unchanged; only references, bindings, aliases and this entry are added.
